header.title: Sfurti Cognitive Toy Collection
header.subtitle: Discover hands-on learning that fosters deep attention, patience, and logical reasoning.

items.name: Cognitive Wooden Logic Puzzle
items.tagline: Step-by-step spatial logic & problem solving for curious minds
items.description: Designed to cultivate visual spatial thinking and sequential reasoning in growing children. Handcrafted with natural wood and non-toxic finishes.

items.name: 3D Architect Building Block Set
items.tagline: Unlocking 3D spatial thinking and creative structural exploration
items.description: Craft unique structures and buildings using precision-cut wooden blocks. Gives children the pride of physical creation.

items.name: Tactile Shape Sorting Box
items.tagline: Essential hand-eye coordination and color recognition for toddlers
items.description: Matching shapes and colors in a physical wooden box builds early tactile awareness and focus without screen distractions.

items.name: Mechanical Construction Kit
items.tagline: Hands-on exploration of simple machines and mechanics
items.description: Assemble gears, bolts, wheels, and mechanisms. A practical introduction to mechanical logic for young aspiring engineers.
